en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad
I know, right?

It's pretty comfy here. I can't help but think
we'd all be just fine staying here.
You and me agree on a lot of stuff.

I bet you wouldn't be bored at all if we
lived here forever.

There's food, clothes, and shelter here.
What else do you need?

Greed is a corrupting influence, y'know?
It'll destroy you from within, Shuichi.
You're less divine than I thought, Shuichi.
Atua thinks so, too!
You and me should start a happy family!

Though I'd miss my island and its people,
this place isn't too bad.

No one tries to stop my rituals, or says
blasphemies like Atua doesn't exist...
And plus, I have you.

Nyhahaha! The more I think about it,
the better it sounds!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
